items.title: Former Malaysia PM Najib to serve remaining jail term at home — if he pays US$12.26 million fine
items.summary: A Pardons Board meeting chaired by the Malaysian king on Friday (Sep 18) reached this decision after an appeal by Najib Razak, who is serving a six-year jail sentence until Aug 23, 2028.
